title: Authority did not decide CCCs and certificates of acceptance; retaining walls (Macandrew Bay, Dunedin)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: Building Act ss 94–99A and NZ Building Code (B1, B2, E1) as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owners (applicants) used an agent and legal adviser; parties include the authority, the purchasers and the licensed building practitioner who carried out work from May 2015.

Matter: the authority's failure to decide two CCCs and grant two certificates of acceptance for alterations, a timber deck and several retaining walls; later proposed or purported refusals followed; amendment B to consent ABA-2008-1319 is involved.
Conclusion: the authority was incorrect not to decide; the reasons given were not sufficiently explicit, specific, clear or valid, and written decisions under ss 95A and 99A were absent.
Decision: authority incorrect in its proposed or purported refusal of amendment B to the first building consent (30 May 2022).

limitations: Comparative only: a New Zealand determination used to test attachment format and content; it cannot establish Alberta performance or applicability.
The determination's decision section is in the same PDF; outcome leakage is true. Use only pages 1-48 as applicant-side input if pages are split.
Facts are taken from the text layer (pypdf); photos, drawings and figures were not visually inspected unless stated.
